summary: Lifeway Foods, Inc. entered into a Master Security Agreement with CIBC Bank USA for equipment financing up to $22 million. The interim facility bears interest at 1-month Term SOFR plus 1.65% and matures June 30, 2027, with conversion to a five-year term note upon acceptance of collateral documentation. This is a routine debt facility arrangement for equipment acquisitions, not an extraordinary corporate event. There are no special-situation elements such as a change of control, restructuring, or capital return. The filing merely discloses a material definitive agreement and corresponding obligation. No further analysis is warranted.
